title: India’s CJP protests: Why tech alone won’t stop exam paper leaks
excerpt: Can computer-based testing stop NEET paper leaks? Experts say governance matters as much as tech.
content_html:
By

India correspondent

Can moving India's biggest entrance examinations from pen and paper to computers finally break the country's seemingly endless cycle of exam question leaks?

The issue gained fresh urgency after weeks of protests over the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET) medical entrance exam forced the resignation of education minister Dharmendra Pradhan. Protesters say more than 20 students died by suicide, with their families blaming the exam scandal for their deaths.

Prime Minister Narendra Modi responded by appointing an expert task force headed by Nandan Nilekani of the Indian IT giant Infosys to overhaul the National Testing Agency (NTA), which runs the exam. Modi recommends, external shifting the tests to computer-based testing (CBT) to make them more secure.

  • How exam scandals threaten the future of India's young people

Hearing petitions on the reforms, the Supreme Court welcomed the government's efforts but cautioned that computer-based testing (CBT) alone would not eliminate the risk of exam paper leaks.

That warning captures the challenge facing the task force: can technology fix what is ultimately a problem of trust, governance and incentives?

The contrasting NEET paper leaks of 2024 and 2026 illustrate why the answer is more complicated than simply digitising exams. NEET uses four versions of the question paper, each containing 180 compulsory questions across physics, chemistry and biology.

The leaks occurred at opposite ends of the exam process.

In 2024, the paper was allegedly leaked after printing, when sealed trunks were opened during transit to exam centres. Investigators said the breach was limited, involving about 40-50 people, and the Supreme Court ruled the exam's overall integrity remained intact, rejecting calls for a re-test.

In 2026, the leak allegedly happened before the paper left the NTA, with teachers accused of leaking it from within the system. Officials say the safeguards on printing, transport and distribution held up. The vulnerability lay at the source, before the secure chain of custody even began.

For Prof V Kamakoti, director of Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Madras and a member of the task force, the two episodes expose where trust in an examination system ultimately resides.

  • Why are thousands protesting for education reform in India?

"The roots of trust lie in two places: the teachers who set the question papers and the invigilators who supervise candidates. If either is compromised, the system is vulnerable," he told the BBC.

Officials have proposed extensive CCTV surveillance, with live feeds monitored from central control rooms. Kamakoti says AI could go further, automatically flagging suspicious behaviour - such as prolonged conversations between invigilators and candidates - so officials can intervene in real time. "At least the invigilator part we can certainly handle."

But he argues that the bigger leap in security lies in moving exams online.

Computer-based testing, he says, would make India's examinations far more secure. "Compromising the technology would be extremely difficult," he said, pointing to more than a decade of experience running large-scale computer-based examinations..

IIT Madras manages Swayam, the Indian government's online learning platform, and has extensive experience conducting large-scale computer-based examinations, including Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE) and advanced Joint Entrance Examination (JEE), required for admission to the country's top engineering colleges.

These systems, Kamakoti says, rely on "red teaming" - teams that constantly probe systems for weaknesses - and "air-gapped" networks physically isolated from the internet.

"No one can hack into that network," he says.

"The systems are designed to withstand technical failures. If a computer crashes or power fails, the timer pauses automatically and resumes on another machine."

But even the most secure technology cannot eliminate the human factor. For Kamakoti, that is where the examination system's "root of trust" lies.

"The biggest challenge is to get trusted question setters," he says.

Preparing a NEET paper is a complex exercise. The exam is conducted in 13 languages, including English, making it one of the world's largest multilingual entrance examinations. It requires subject experts, translators, reviewers and moderators. Kamakoti estimates that around 50 people may be involved in setting papers.

"If even one person in that entire set is compromised, we are gone," he said.

Computer-based testing removes one major vulnerability by eliminating the need to print, transport and store millions of question papers.

So why hasn't NEET already gone digital? Kamakoti says NEET has remained a paper-based exam, where answers are shaded on machine-readable answer sheets, because it is conducted in a single session for all candidates to ensure fairness.

India can currently accommodate only about 300,000 candidates in one computer-based testing session, far short of NEET's 2.2 million test-takers, he says. "Moving to CBT would therefore require either a massive expansion of testing capacity or conducting the exam over multiple sessions."

But not everyone believes moving online is, by itself, the answer.

Dr Debananda Misra at the School of Public Policy, IIT Delhi agrees that CBT can significantly reduce opportunities for paper leaks. But he believes the debate risks becoming too narrowly focused on technology.

"CBT is not a silver bullet," he told the BBC. "It can strengthen exam security and improve efficiency, but it does not address the deeper incentives that drive malpractice."

Those incentives are formidable.

Nearly two million students appeared for NEET this year. More than half qualified. But the heavily subsidised government medical colleges, where an entire medical degree can cost less than 30,000 rupees (about $313; £235) have room for fewer than 6% of those who qualify - or under 3% of everyone who takes the examination. Candidates who miss out often face private college fees running into tens or even hundreds of thousands of rupees.

Investigators say that scarcity has fuelled increasingly sophisticated paper-leak rackets, linking teachers, middlemen and exam-centre staff. Computer-based testing closes some of those vulnerabilities. But it creates others.

Misra says even relatively minor technical failures can affect candidates in ways that are difficult to quantify.

"A non-functional mouse is not just about pausing the timer," he said. "It is also about disruption to concentration."

He also worries about equity.

He says success in CBT increasingly depends not only on subject knowledge but also on digital familiarity and opportunities to practise in simulated testing environments - advantages that remain unevenly distributed and may favour students attending coaching institutes over those from less-resourced schools.

More fundamentally, Misra argues, India's examination system places too much weight on a single test.

"As long as a single test determines access to scarce opportunities, there will be strong incentives for exam malpractice, regardless of the testing format," he said.

Misra argues that examination agencies need stronger governance through tighter procedures, regular audits, greater accountability and stricter enforcement. He also suggests multiple equivalent question papers allocated randomly, or localised papers, so that a breach in one location does not compromise an entire national examination.

Over time, he believes India should also reduce its dependence on "single, high-stakes entrance tests" by creating multiple opportunities for assessment and broader pathways into higher education.

"If the purpose is to generate a ranked list and match students to institutions," he said, "perhaps we should also think about creating greater diversity on both sides."

Modi has repeatedly vowed , externalto crack down on exam fraud. Since 2023, he has promised that the "paper-leak mafia, external" would be "held accountable", said those "playing with the future of young people will not be spared", and insisted the government was acting on a "war footing" to stop leaks.

Following the 2024 paper leak, his government appointed a high-level committee led by former space agency chief. It produced the most comprehensive review yet of India's examination system. But only about 57% of its 100-plus recommendations, external have reportedly been implemented - and paper leaks continue to plague exams.

There is little time to overhaul India's exam system. The country's annual entrance exam season for engineering, medicine, universities and postgraduate admissions begins in December and runs through May or June. Kamakoti says any major changes will have to be finalised within the next month or two to be ready for the next cycle.

Ultimately, the task force will be judged not by how many exams move online, but by whether students once again believe the system is fair.

sentences.zh: 印度理工学院马德拉斯分校管理着印度政府的在线学习平台 Swayam，在开展大规模计算机考试方面拥有丰富的经验，包括工程研究生能力测试 (GATE) 和高级联合入学考试 (JEE)，这些都是进入该国顶尖工程学院所需的。

blocks.html_en: These systems, Kamakoti says, rely on "red teaming" - teams that constantly probe systems for weaknesses - and "air-gapped" networks physically isolated from the internet.

sentences.en: These systems, Kamakoti says, rely on "red teaming" - teams that constantly probe systems for weaknesses - and "air-gapped" networks physically isolated from the internet.
sentences.zh: 卡马科蒂说，这些系统依赖于“红队”——不断探测系统弱点的团队——以及与互联网物理隔离的“气隙”网络。

blocks.html_en: "No one can hack into that network," he says.

sentences.en: "No one can hack into that network," he says.
sentences.zh: “没有人可以侵入该网络，”他说。

blocks.html_en: "The systems are designed to withstand technical failures. If a computer crashes or power fails, the timer pauses automatically and resumes on another machine."

sentences.en: "The systems are designed to withstand technical failures.
sentences.zh: “这些系统的设计能够承受技术故障。

sentences.en: If a computer crashes or power fails, the timer pauses automatically and resumes on another machine."
sentences.zh: 如果计算机崩溃或断电，计时器会自动暂停并在另一台计算机上恢复。”

blocks.html_en: But even the most secure technology cannot eliminate the human factor. For Kamakoti, that is where the examination system's "root of trust" lies.

sentences.en: But even the most secure technology cannot eliminate the human factor.
sentences.zh: 但即使是最安全的技术也无法消除人为因素。

sentences.en: For Kamakoti, that is where the examination system's "root of trust" lies.
sentences.zh: 对于卡马科蒂来说，这就是考试制度的“信任之根”所在。

blocks.html_en: "The biggest challenge is to get trusted question setters," he says.

sentences.en: "The biggest challenge is to get trusted question setters," he says.
sentences.zh: “最大的挑战是找到值得信赖的提问者，”他说。

blocks.html_en: Preparing a NEET paper is a complex exercise. The exam is conducted in 13 languages, including English, making it one of the world's largest multilingual entrance examinations. It requires subject experts, translators, reviewers and moderators. Kamakoti estimates that around 50 people may be involved in setting papers.

sentences.en: Preparing a NEET paper is a complex exercise.
sentences.zh: 准备 NEET 论文是一项复杂的工作。

sentences.en: The exam is conducted in 13 languages, including English, making it one of the world's largest multilingual entrance examinations.
sentences.zh: 该考试以包括英语在内的 13 种语言进行，使其成为世界上最大的多语言入学考试之一。

sentences.en: It requires subject experts, translators, reviewers and moderators.
sentences.zh: 它需要学科专家、翻译人员、审稿人和主持人。

sentences.en: Kamakoti estimates that around 50 people may be involved in setting papers.
sentences.zh: Kamakoti 估计大约有 50 人可能参与制定文件。

blocks.html_en: "If even one person in that entire set is compromised, we are gone," he said.

sentences.en: "If even one person in that entire set is compromised, we are gone," he said.
sentences.zh: “如果整个团队中的一个人受到损害，我们就会消失，”他说。

blocks.html_en: Computer-based testing removes one major vulnerability by eliminating the need to print, transport and store millions of question papers.

sentences.en: Computer-based testing removes one major vulnerability by eliminating the need to print, transport and store millions of question papers.
sentences.zh: 基于计算机的测试消除了一个主要漏洞，无需打印、运输和存储数百万份试卷。

sentences.zh: 许多学生表示他们对印度的考试制度完全失去了信任

blocks.html_en: So why hasn't NEET already gone digital? Kamakoti says NEET has remained a paper-based exam, where answers are shaded on machine-readable answer sheets, because it is conducted in a single session for all candidates to ensure fairness.

sentences.en: So why hasn't NEET already gone digital?
sentences.zh: 那么为什么 NEET 还没有实现数字化呢？

sentences.en: Kamakoti says NEET has remained a paper-based exam, where answers are shaded on machine-readable answer sheets, because it is conducted in a single session for all candidates to ensure fairness.
sentences.zh: 卡马科蒂表示，NEET 仍然是纸质考试，答案在机器可读的答卷上用阴影表示，因为它是在一次考试中对所有考生进行的，以确保公平性。

blocks.html_en: India can currently accommodate only about 300,000 candidates in one computer-based testing session, far short of NEET's 2.2 million test-takers, he says. "Moving to CBT would therefore require either a massive expansion of testing capacity or conducting the exam over multiple sessions."

sentences.en: India can currently accommodate only about 300,000 candidates in one computer-based testing session, far short of NEET's 2.2 million test-takers, he says.
sentences.zh: 他表示，印度目前只能容纳大约 30 万名考生参加一场机考，远低于 NEET 的 220 万名考生。

sentences.en: "Moving to CBT would therefore require either a massive expansion of testing capacity or conducting the exam over multiple sessions."
sentences.zh: “因此，转向 CBT 要么需要大规模扩展测试能力，要么需要进行多次考试。”

blocks.html_en: But not everyone believes moving online is, by itself, the answer.

sentences.en: But not everyone believes moving online is, by itself, the answer.
sentences.zh: 但并非所有人都认为转向线上本身就是答案。

blocks.html_en: Dr Debananda Misra at the School of Public Policy, IIT Delhi agrees that CBT can significantly reduce opportunities for paper leaks. But he believes the debate risks becoming too narrowly focused on technology.

sentences.en: Dr Debananda Misra at the School of Public Policy, IIT Delhi agrees that CBT can significantly reduce opportunities for paper leaks.
sentences.zh: 印度理工学院德里分校公共政策学院的 Debananda Misra 博士同意 CBT 可以显着减少论文泄露的机会。

sentences.en: But he believes the debate risks becoming too narrowly focused on technology.
sentences.zh: 但他认为这场辩论有可能过于狭隘地集中在技术上。

blocks.html_en: "CBT is not a silver bullet," he told the BBC. "It can strengthen exam security and improve efficiency, but it does not address the deeper incentives that drive malpractice."

sentences.en: "CBT is not a silver bullet," he told the BBC.
sentences.zh: “CBT 不是灵丹妙药，”他告诉 BBC。

sentences.en: "It can strengthen exam security and improve efficiency, but it does not address the deeper incentives that drive malpractice."
sentences.zh: “它可以加强考试安全性并提高效率，但它并不能解决导致舞弊的更深层次的动机。”

blocks.html_en: Those incentives are formidable.

sentences.en: Those incentives are formidable.
sentences.zh: 这些激励措施是巨大的。

blocks.html_en: Nearly two million students appeared for NEET this year. More than half qualified. But the heavily subsidised government medical colleges, where an entire medical degree can cost less than 30,000 rupees (about $313; £235) have room for fewer than 6% of those who qualify - or under 3% of everyone who takes the examination. Candidates who miss out often face private college fees running into tens or even hundreds of thousands of rupees.

sentences.en: Nearly two million students appeared for NEET this year.
sentences.zh: 今年有近200万学生参加了NEET。

sentences.zh: 但在接受大量补贴的政府医学院中，获得整个医学学位的费用不到 30,000 卢比（约合 313 美元；235 英镑），只有不到 6% 的符合资格的人有名额，或者不到 3% 的参加考试的人。

blocks.html_en: Investigators say that scarcity has fuelled increasingly sophisticated paper-leak rackets, linking teachers, middlemen and exam-centre staff. Computer-based testing closes some of those vulnerabilities. But it creates others.

blocks.html_en: "A non-functional mouse is not just about pausing the timer," he said. "It is also about disruption to concentration."

sentences.en: "A non-functional mouse is not just about pausing the timer," he said.
sentences.zh: “不起作用的鼠标不仅仅是暂停计时器，”他说。

blocks.html_en: He says success in CBT increasingly depends not only on subject knowledge but also on digital familiarity and opportunities to practise in simulated testing environments - advantages that remain unevenly distributed and may favour students attending coaching institutes over those from less-resourced schools.

sentences.en: He says success in CBT increasingly depends not only on subject knowledge but also on digital familiarity and opportunities to practise in simulated testing environments - advantages that remain unevenly distributed and may favour students attending coaching institutes over those from less-resourced schools.

blocks.html_en: More fundamentally, Misra argues, India's examination system places too much weight on a single test.

sentences.en: More fundamentally, Misra argues, India's examination system places too much weight on a single test.
sentences.zh: 米斯拉认为，更根本的是，印度的考试制度过于重视单一考试。

blocks.html_en: "As long as a single test determines access to scarce opportunities, there will be strong incentives for exam malpractice, regardless of the testing format," he said.

sentences.en: "As long as a single test determines access to scarce opportunities, there will be strong incentives for exam malpractice, regardless of the testing format," he said.

blocks.html_en: Misra argues that examination agencies need stronger governance through tighter procedures, regular audits, greater accountability and stricter enforcement. He also suggests multiple equivalent question papers allocated randomly, or localised papers, so that a breach in one location does not compromise an entire national examination.

sentences.en: Misra argues that examination agencies need stronger governance through tighter procedures, regular audits, greater accountability and stricter enforcement.
sentences.zh: 米斯拉认为，考试机构需要通过更严格的程序、定期审计、更大的责任和更严格的执法来加强治理。

sentences.en: He also suggests multiple equivalent question papers allocated randomly, or localised papers, so that a breach in one location does not compromise an entire national examination.
sentences.zh: 他还建议随机分配多份同等试卷或本地化试卷，这样一个地方的违规行为就不会影响整个国家考试。

blocks.html_en: Over time, he believes India should also reduce its dependence on "single, high-stakes entrance tests" by creating multiple opportunities for assessment and broader pathways into higher education.

sentences.en: Over time, he believes India should also reduce its dependence on "single, high-stakes entrance tests" by creating multiple opportunities for assessment and broader pathways into higher education.
sentences.zh: 他认为，随着时间的推移，印度还应该通过创造多种评估机会和更广泛的高等教育途径，减少对“单一、高风险入学考试”的依赖。

blocks.html_en: "If the purpose is to generate a ranked list and match students to institutions," he said, "perhaps we should also think about creating greater diversity on both sides."

sentences.en: "If the purpose is to generate a ranked list and match students to institutions," he said, "perhaps we should also think about creating greater diversity on both sides."
sentences.zh: “如果目的是生成一个排名列表并将学生与院校进行匹配，”他说，“也许我们还应该考虑为双方创造更大的多样性。”

content_html_zh:
By

他们对应的是印度

将印度最大的入学考试从纸笔考试转移到电脑上，最终能否打破该国看似无止尽的试题泄露循环？

在针对国家资格暨入学考试（NEET）医学入学考试的抗议活动持续数周后，这个问题变得更加紧迫，迫使教育部长达门德拉·普拉丹（Dharmendra Pradhan）辞职。 抗议者称，有 20 多名学生自杀身亡，他们的家人将他们的死亡归咎于考试丑闻。

作为回应，纳伦德拉·莫迪总理任命了一个由印度 IT 巨头印孚瑟斯 (Infosys) 的南丹·尼勒卡尼 (Nandan Nilekani) 领导的专家工作组，对负责举办考试的国家测试局 (NTA) 进行全面改革。 莫迪建议，将测试从外部转移到基于计算机的测试（CBT），以使其更加安全。

  • 考试丑闻如何威胁印度年轻人的未来

在听取了有关改革的请愿书后，最高法院对政府的努力表示欢迎，但警告称，仅靠计算机考试（CBT）并不能消除试卷泄露的风险。

这一警告抓住了工作组面临的挑战：技术能否解决最终的信任、治理和激励问题？

2024 年和 2026 年 NEET 试卷泄露的对比说明了为什么答案比简单的数字化考试更复杂。 NEET 使用四个版本的试卷，每个版本包含 180 道必答题，涉及物理、化学和生物。

泄漏发生在考试过程的两端。

据称，2024 年，该试卷在打印后被泄露，当时密封的行李箱在运往考试中心的途中被打开。 调查人员表示，此次违规行为有限，涉及约 40 至 50 人，最高法院裁定考试的整体完整性保持不变，拒绝重新考试的要求。

据称，2026 年的泄露发生在该论文离开 NTA 之前，教师被指控从系统内部泄露该论文。 官员们表示，印刷、运输和分发方面的保障措施仍然有效。 在安全监管链开始之前，漏洞就已存在。

对于印度马德拉斯理工学院 (IIT) 所长兼工作组成员 V 卡马科蒂 (V Kamakoti) 教授来说，这两起事件暴露了人们对考试制度的信任最终所在。

  • 为什么印度有数千人抗议教育改革？

“信任的根源在于两个地方：出试卷的老师和监督考生的监考人员。 如果其中任何一个受到损害，系统就很容易受到攻击。”他告诉 BBC。

官员们提议进行广泛的闭路电视监控，并从中央控制室监控实时直播。 卡马科蒂表示，人工智能可以更进一步，自动标记可疑行为，例如监考人员和考生之间长时间的对话，以便官员可以实时干预。 “至少监考人员的部分我们肯定能搞定。”

但他认为，安全方面的更大飞跃在于将考试转移到网上。

他说，基于计算机的考试将使印度的考试更加安全。 “破坏这项技术将是极其困难的，”他说，并指出了十多年运行大规模计算机考试的经验。

印度理工学院马德拉斯分校管理着印度政府的在线学习平台 Swayam，在开展大规模计算机考试方面拥有丰富的经验，包括工程研究生能力测试 (GATE) 和高级联合入学考试 (JEE)，这些都是进入该国顶尖工程学院所需的。

卡马科蒂说，这些系统依赖于“红队”——不断探测系统弱点的团队——以及与互联网物理隔离的“气隙”网络。

“没有人可以侵入该网络，”他说。

“这些系统的设计能够承受技术故障。 如果计算机崩溃或断电，计时器会自动暂停并在另一台计算机上恢复。”

但即使是最安全的技术也无法消除人为因素。 对于卡马科蒂来说，这就是考试制度的“信任之根”所在。

“最大的挑战是找到值得信赖的提问者，”他说。

准备 NEET 论文是一项复杂的工作。 该考试以包括英语在内的 13 种语言进行，使其成为世界上最大的多语言入学考试之一。 它需要学科专家、翻译人员、审稿人和主持人。 Kamakoti 估计大约有 50 人可能参与制定文件。

“如果整个团队中的一个人受到损害，我们就会消失，”他说。

基于计算机的测试消除了一个主要漏洞，无需打印、运输和存储数百万份试卷。

那么为什么 NEET 还没有实现数字化呢？ 卡马科蒂表示，NEET 仍然是纸质考试，答案在机器可读的答卷上用阴影表示，因为它是在一次考试中对所有考生进行的，以确保公平性。

他表示，印度目前只能容纳大约 30 万名考生参加一场机考，远低于 NEET 的 220 万名考生。 “因此，转向 CBT 要么需要大规模扩展测试能力，要么需要进行多次考试。”

但并非所有人都认为转向线上本身就是答案。

印度理工学院德里分校公共政策学院的 Debananda Misra 博士同意 CBT 可以显着减少论文泄露的机会。 但他认为这场辩论有可能过于狭隘地集中在技术上。

“CBT 不是灵丹妙药，”他告诉 BBC。 “它可以加强考试安全性并提高效率，但它并不能解决导致舞弊的更深层次的动机。”

这些激励措施是巨大的。

今年有近200万学生参加了NEET。 超过一半合格。 但在接受大量补贴的政府医学院中，获得整个医学学位的费用不到 30,000 卢比（约合 313 美元；235 英镑），只有不到 6% 的符合资格的人有名额，或者不到 3% 的参加考试的人。 错过的候选人通常会面临高达数万甚至数十万卢比的私立大学费用。

调查人员表示，资源的稀缺助长了日益复杂的试卷泄露行为，将教师、中间人和考试中心工作人员联系在一起。 基于计算机的测试消除了其中一些漏洞。 但它创造了其他人。

米斯拉表示，即使是相对较小的技术故障也会以难以量化的方式影响候选人。

“不起作用的鼠标不仅仅是暂停计时器，”他说。 “这也与注意力的分散有关。”

他还担心公平问题。

他表示，CBT 的成功不仅越来越依赖于学科知识，还取决于对数字技术的熟悉程度以及在模拟测试环境中练习的机会——这些优势仍然分布不均，与来自资源匮乏学校的学生相比，可能有利于就读辅导机构的学生。

米斯拉认为，更根本的是，印度的考试制度过于重视单一考试。

他说：“只要一次考试决定了稀缺机会的获得，无论考试形式如何，考试舞弊都会受到强烈的激励。”

米斯拉认为，考试机构需要通过更严格的程序、定期审计、更大的责任和更严格的执法来加强治理。 他还建议随机分配多份同等试卷或本地化试卷，这样一个地方的违规行为就不会影响整个国家考试。

他认为，随着时间的推移，印度还应该通过创造多种评估机会和更广泛的高等教育途径，减少对“单一、高风险入学考试”的依赖。

“如果目的是生成一个排名列表并将学生与院校进行匹配，”他说，“也许我们还应该考虑为双方创造更大的多样性。”

莫迪多次对外表示要打击考试舞弊行为。 自2023年以来，他承诺将“追究外部泄密黑手党的责任”，称那些“玩弄年轻人未来的人将不会幸免”，并坚称政府正在采取“战备”行动来阻止泄密。

2024 年文件泄露后，他的政府任命了一个由前航天局局长领导的高级别委员会。 它对印度考试制度进行了迄今为止最全面的审查。 但据报道，其 100 多条外部建议中只有约 57% 得到了实施，而且试卷泄露仍然困扰着考试。

几乎没有时间彻底改革印度的考试制度。 该国一年一度的工程、医学、大学和研究生入学考试季从 12 月开始，一直持续到 5 月或 6 月。 卡马科蒂表示，任何重大变化都必须在未来一两个月内完成，以便为下一个周期做好准备。

最终，评判工作组的标准不是有多少考试在线进行，而是学生是否再次相信该系统是公平的。
